name: Nodoka Nagasawa
source: Nodoka is an academic superstar who humbles even Makoto in the competition for biggest brain around. Eccentric when amped on coffee, she may be the only person who loves reading more than her childhood friend Futaba -- especially stories of an intimate nature, which she also writes.
